description: Encyclopedia definitions. Selection, highlights, unlocked state and navigation links belong to each UI session.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable encyclopedia definition identity, not a spawned enemy.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: Original visible MON record index; -1 denotes a native-only entry. The 72 out-of-list records remain import provenance.

columns.name: display_order
columns.description: Unique list position; 999 is the current three-digit view policy.

columns.name: preview_table_index
columns.description: MENU9 preview-table compatibility index (#200/#55); not a spawn identity. Uses that table's model, equipment and palette policy.

columns.name: unlock
columns.description: Any defeated actor subtype in the range, or explicitly always visible (no progress write).

columns.name: first_defeated_subtype
columns.description: First actor subtype tested in the saved defeat flags (#203).

columns.name: defeated_subtype_count
columns.description: Number of consecutive subtypes; range end is exclusive.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Native text ID for the readable name; no embedded list indent.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Native text ID for the description.
